source.study_title: Mammals adjust diel activity across gradients of urbanization

evidence_used: README schema/file descriptions from the response-blind package inventory

gates.reason: independent 2017-2018 UWIN response dataset; not MICA v3, Snapshot Japan 2023, or their derivatives

README declares city, site, observation date/time, coordinates and time-category availability, but no separate response-independent deployment table with start/end intervals is declared; raw city files and analysis RDS objects are response-bearing and remain unopened

the ten geographic regimes use one shared UWIN sampling design; no second survey/source/protocol domain overlapping geography is declared, so geography cannot be crossed with source/protocol under the frozen E5 acceptable designs

published methods place one camera at each site and declare no paired/simultaneous sensor calibration, independent detection-distance calibration, or auxiliary detection stream; the response-blind package inventory does not expose a separately identifying detection path
453 physical sites exceed the frozen count minima, but no E5 geographic train/heldout split is frozen because earlier hard-stop gates fail
the study spans January 2017 through December 2018, but not all cities were continuously sampled and split-specific six-month support is not opened or frozen after G3/G4 failure
candidate fails G3 and G4 before selected-candidate model freeze

reuse_boundary.reason: multi-city diel data are scientifically relevant, but they do not satisfy E5's pre-frozen source-crossing and detection-identification requirements
